_comment: Required status checks on main. 'all' applies to every managed repo; a repo's own list is added to it. Add a repo's CI checks here once its CI exists, never before (a required check that never runs blocks every merge). A check from a reusable workflow in this repo is named '<caller job> / <job>' and goes in 'all' once every repo has the caller (rulesets/repo-lists.json, required_files).
